scope: Regime validity, authoritative scanner recommendation, consistent fixed playbooks and opt-in adaptive simulated-paper routing; ML excluded
baseline_kind: pre-batch working tree including earlier authorized edits; not Git HEAD
behavior_changes: Global regime uses verified completed daily BTC candles. Shared validation rejects malformed, stale, forming and gapped input before cache reuse.
Shared Wilder ADX seeds/smoothing and simultaneous directional-move ties replace inconsistent implementations.
Display and advice share one daily observation with named4h/weekly context, source close times and bounded expiry; missing inputs are unavailable, not STEALTH.
Weekly advice requires fresh weekly evidence. Directional routing is symmetric and constrained by allowed modes; high volatility/thin liquidity abstains.
Fixed scanner/paper/live applies one complete selected playbook before indicators/planning: MACD, SMC, timeframe roles, VAP, planner overrides, qualification gate.
Bot restrictions cannot waive the mode minimum, under either legacy or thesis policy. Paper can halve size between qualified floor and stricter full-size gate.
STEALTH cross-profile cascade disabled while preserving no-swing restriction; deleted unused legacy recommendation function after consumer check.
Adaptive simulated paper only; initial mode immediate, changes require two increasing4h observations. Missing/unsuitable inputs wait while position monitoring continues.
Plans, signal logs, active positions, checkpoints and completed records retain originating strategy provenance; cross-mode incoming plans cannot replace pending/open trades.
Separate bot/scanner choices in UI. Recommendation expires/refreshes and applies only when the user chooses it.

limitations: Offline synthetic paper fixtures establish software behavior, not forward profitability, optimal recommendation routing or calibrated win probabilities.
Global daily ATR cutoffs, intraday planner volatility bands and representative signal frequency remain uncalibrated.
Existing fixed-profile pullback/backing heuristics are not fully consolidated into timeframe-role fields; nested triggers are not mandatory for every fallback setup.
Policy provenance is not a full historical replay snapshot of all inputs/planner/management settings.
Serialized inline worker fixtures do not certify actual process spawning/concurrency, exchange fills, live startup or automatic restart.
Frontend checks use static rendered markup and pure freshness tests, not a browser/mobile interaction session.
No service restart, deployment, bot startup, credential access, real orders, ML implementation/training or historical record rewrite performed for this batch.
Runtime protected hashes were captured for the final verification phase, not at batch start; external running processes may write runtime data.
